title: SCRIMS: statistical inference of functional interaction sites and shared motifs from structure-prediction screens
description: SCRIMS (SCReening for Interaction Motifs and Sites) analyses structure-prediction screens of one bait protein against many preys. It builds a bait–prey confidence matrix from predicted aligned error, calls interaction sites by recurrence (a permutation test with Benjamini–Hochberg control) and strength, merges sites into 3-D interfaces, lists the preys and prey residues that bind each interface, and tests whether unrelated preys bind with similar residues (shared sequence motifs), with a consensus sequence and known-motif (ELM) suggestions. Outputs: an interactive HTML report, JSON and TSV tables, and a ChimeraX script. Includes ELM class tables (elm.eu.org) and Pfam clan mappings used by the known-motif step.
